visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with thick black hair and a black T-shirt stands indoors. He holds a brown egg in his right hand. He looks directly into the camera with an expressive face, speaking animatedly. The background shows a simple room with a bunk bed ladder. (2) He gestures towards the egg, emphasizing his words. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused. He holds the egg steadily between his thumb and fingers. (3) He produces an orange lighter and ignites it beneath the egg. A steady yellow and blue flame licks the bottom of the shell. He maintains eye contact with the camera while performing this action. (4) A sudden editing cut occurs, and the egg is replaced by a clear plastic-wrapped package of chocolate bread. The man's expression shifts to exaggerated surprise, mouth agape. (5) He holds the bread package close to the lens, displaying the label. He continues to speak excitedly, concluding the segment with a humorous look.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous magic trick skit based on a linguistic pun. The creator pretends to use a lighter to transform a raw egg into a package of chocolate rolls, utilizing the Hokkien word for egg ('neng') to create a pun on the idiom 'practice makes perfect' (shú néng shēng qiǎo).
